content.text:
Here's what I got from exercising Entire live against this repo — plus the one piece of "simulated action" that needs your go-ahead.

## What Entire is already doing (no action needed)

It's silently recording **this very session** as I work. `entire session current` shows:

```
Session 9f40ebd0…  ·  Claude Code  ·  claude-opus-4-8[1m]  ·  active
Turns: 2   Tokens: 109.5k (Input 4 · Cache read 77.5k · Cache write 31.2k · Output 779)
Last prompt: "this repo uses the new entire.io link. i want to see some simulated action…"
```

And `entire session tokens` even gives optimization advice:
> *Cache write is elevated; avoid broad new context and narrow the next read before continuing.*

So the baseline benefit: **every agent session (prompts, model, turns, token economics) is captured automatically** — no setup per session.

## The payoff features — and why they're empty right now

| Command | What it gives you | Status in this repo |
|---|---|---|
| `entire why <file>:<line>` | The commit **+ checkpoint + the AI prompt + session** that produced a line | Needs ≥1 committed checkpoint |
| `entire search "..."` | Semantic search across checkpoints/commits/sessions | `no matching repositories… is the repo mirrored?` |
| `entire checkpoint list` | Agent work bundled per commit | `checkpoints 0` |
| `entire recap` / `activity` | Throughput / iteration / continuity / streak, you vs team | `0 sessions` |

They're all empty for one reason: **agent work only becomes a checkpoint when you commit it**, and nothing's been committed through Entire yet. This repo is brand-new to it.

## The simulated action to actually *see* it

To demonstrate the whole loop end-to-end, I'd:
1. Create a throwaway file (e.g. `scratch/entire-demo.md`) on a short-lived branch `entire-demo`
2. Commit it → watch it become a **checkpoint** linked to this session
3. Run `entire why scratch/entire-demo.md:1` → show it tracing the line back to *this prompt*
4. Run `entire checkpoint list` / `search` → now populated
5. Delete the branch to leave `master` untouched

That commit is the only write involved (everything else was read-only). Your CLAUDE.md says commit only when asked, and the Entire hook says ask before writes — so I want your OK first.
